Middlesbrough deploys extra police amid fears of escalating gang violence

Hundreds of extra police officers have been deployed to Middlesbrough following a series of incidents and fears of escalating gang warfare. Local residents have expressed concerns about safety, with reports of nine deaths in five days, including a seven-year-old girl. The increased police presence follows violence linked to an A66 crash, with authorities making 17 arrests in connection with organized crime. Football club Middlesbrough FC and fans held a one-minute applause for officers killed in the A66 crash.
